_derived_from: Ghidra 12.1.4 decompile of yugi_pc.exe / kaiba_pc.exe (see docs/reverse-notes.md). Addresses are VAs in the shipped exes. 'inferred' marks a meaning read from behaviour, not from a name.
rng: MT19937 (0x527600 yugi, 0x533640 kaiba), default seed 4357 (0x1105). rand()%n via 0x401ba0. CRT rand() only seeds the duel shuffle command (op 0x60).

collection_percent.formula: owned / obtainable * 100 (integer). obtainable = cards 1..1114 with card_pack & (1 << game_index); owned = low byte of the per-card u16 save counter != 0

streak.fields: last_result_kind (1 = last duel won, 2 = otherwise) and streak length (u8, saturates at 255)
streak.update: after every duel: if (kind==1) == (result==1) streak++ else streak = 1; kind = result==1 ? 1 : 2. Results 1/2/3 also bump per-level 11/11/10-bit win/loss/draw counters (inferred win/lose/draw).
streak.evidence: yugi 0x430940 (DAT_00a071d5 kind, DAT_00a071d6 length; counters 0x537480/0x5374b0/0x5374f0 in DAT_00a071d8[level])

rewards.cards_per_win: 3 if duel mode == 1 (inferred: match) else 1 (yugi 0x4344b0 tests DAT_005a5778 == 1; kaiba 0x437970)
rewards.draw: each card = uniform pick from the obtainable pool (no rarity weights); cards within one reward are distinct

reroll_for_new.yugi: attempts = 1 + (collection% >= 80); a draw that contains at least one unowned card is kept, otherwise redraw while attempts remain

rewards.grant: owned counter++ (cap 255), 'new' flag bit 0x4000 set on the u16 (yugi 0x536fb0)

joey_bonus_gauge.field: DAT_00a54dad (0..19), stored per reward screen at +0x38/+0x3c
joey_bonus_gauge.rule: after each reward: gauge += rand%10+1 (single duel) or rand%8+3 (match). If gauge > 19: when the draw held no new card -> gauge = 0 and bonus flag set; otherwise gauge = 17. While the bonus flag is set the next reward resets the gauge to 0.
joey_bonus_gauge.meaning: inferred: a 'lucky' bonus that triggers after a run of rewards without new cards; what the flag grants was not traced

yugi.reading: j/jj = easier decks offered after losses, k/kk = harder decks after wins (inferred from which streak selects them)

kaiba.pool_select: pool 1 when the save owns any card whose pack bits include an earlier game but not Kaiba (= cards carried over from Yugi via the shared 'Yu-Gi-Oh! Power of Chaos Common' save); else pool 0 (0x45fc70)

slots.names: slot 0 = J (easy 1), 1 = JJ (easy 2), 2..9 = normal rotation, 10 = K, 11 = KK, 12 = KKK (hard)

kaiba.note: rules are tried top to bottom inside each collection band; a failed roll falls through to the default

joey.state: level = DAT_00a54db3, carried_over = DAT_00a54db4 (1 if the save owns a card whose pack bits include an earlier game but not Joey, 0x5bedd0), streak kind/length = DAT_00a54daf / DAT_00a54db0

cpu_decks.pick: data/J/file/CPU_<nnn>.ydc, nnn = table[level*5 + rand%5], level clamped 1..7

ful_decks.pick: data/J/file/FUL_<name>.ydc, k = level + 2 clamped 3..9, name = uniform from the row

level_ladder.level_up: after a win, if u < (carried_over ? 9 : 7) and win streak >= up[u]: level += 1, streak = 0
level_ladder.level_down: after a loss, if u > 2*carried_over + 1 and losing streak >= down[u]: level -= 1, streak = 0
level_ladder.gate: only when DAT_005f3254 != 0 (a mode value 1..3 set at 0x447xxx; inferred: ladder applies in the normal CPU duel mode)

values.2: next duel of a match (counter DAT_005a576b++, mode stays 1)
values.3: duel without reset of match state
